release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.24 - Android & iOS Production FCM Notifications Complete Fix:
- Fixed server to always send FCM notifications for iOS devices (even when online)
- Uploaded Production APNs Authentication Key to Firebase Console
- Enhanced iOS FCM notification handling for Release/TestFlight/App Store builds
- Improved server-side platform detection for iOS vs Android
- Fixed notification delivery for background and terminated app states
- Enhanced logging for iOS FCM notification debugging
- All iOS FCM configurations verified and optimized for production
- Server now properly handles iOS notifications in all app states
